name: The Second Line
description: A parallel embankment carrying nothing at all.
arrival: An embankment running alongside the first, the same height and the same age, with no iron on it. Either it was lifted or it was never laid.
notes: Two lines were built and one was abandoned first, which says the traffic was once heavy enough to need doubling. That is a whole civilisation stated in an earthwork, and nobody on the map remarks on it.
